about: Swift Current is a city in southwestern Saskatchewan on the Trans-Canada Highway and the Swift Current Creek. Prairie agriculture, a regional service role, and Chinook winds off the open plains shape daily life. The city anchors trade and healthcare for a wide farm hinterland. About 16,000 people live in Swift Current.
